strings: m_c's longcough has caused {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to develop silvercough.

It's whitecough season again, and r_c0's been checking each Clanmate for the illness. m_c is surprised when r_c0 shakes {PRONOUN/r_c/poss} head and calls {PRONOUN/m_c/object} into the medicine den, it seems {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} usual cough has masked the silvercough.
m_c's coughing has been a lot worse and a lot more frequent recently. Talking with r_c0, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} unsurprised to discover it's compounded by silvercough.
